title: NPAP: Network Pharmacology Analysis Platform
description: A one-stop network pharmacology analysis platform: target acquisition (DisGeNET / DGIdb / Open Targets / ChEMBL), STRING PPI network construction, GO/KEGG enrichment analysis, AutoDock Vina molecular docking, and GEO transcriptomics with six-algorithm ML consensus screening to shortlist targets for wet-lab validation. 网络药理学一站式分析平台：输入药物与疾病名称，自动完成靶点获取、PPI 网络构建、富集分析、分子对接与机器学习共识筛选。
